claim_boundary: Mixed retention: all 64 candidate episode records have exact producer-byte copies and separate path-normalized copies; producer and normalized SHA-256/size bindings are recorded. Normalized records preserve scenario, planner, metric, event, and outcome fields. These files lack detailed step/planner traces and are not portable replay bundles by themselves because candidate-specific route overrides are not retained for every case. No feasibility or planner safety claim.
